findings.detail: A serialized queue gives every real HTTP request a distinct globally monotonic (caseId,index) and records its actual executionBackend. Dependent forwarding waits for the previous request's genuine certificate/adoption. Rust requests require no Native SDK creates; Native requests require SDK and real PG shadow for observer-covered tables. A DTO ID is never ownership, and a certificate failure halts later writers.

UI2 requires the already reviewed Root/C-admitted new-environment singleton lease for the same run and literal m2-ui2.attachment-max-upload-size scope. Every actual canonical GET/PATCH records full expected-after through the existing helper. Final writer/observer drain precedes exact complete-row restoration and independent committed verification before user cleanup. No setting own/delete or generic mutable borrow.

Exact original prepared draft contract anchors are followed by real current Native submit with immutable intents, SDK/outer COMMIT and independent row evidence. Browser VP reject, real Native resubmit, and current Todo approve retain original semantics. The one readonly VP principal is explicit; actual owned auth_session and generated approval/Todo rows still need their own genuine certificates. Current base account username/userId fields were checked against their producer.

Only the separately reviewed exact original K draft cohort entry is used. Current Native detail must actually show a confirmable draft, then real Native confirmation certifies its project_receipt_judgment_freeze using SDK/outer COMMIT; this table is outside the 34-table PG observer, so no PG proof is claimed for it. All observer-covered SDK tables additionally need real PG shadows. No production R4/new producer gate is invented.

Actual complete provider table must be empty before creating one run-owned local provider; selector uses existing immutable provider_type/created_by, not an invented key_prefix identity. Actual complete row/command prefix verifies the run key. Response IDs must already be independently owned before upload completion, mark-final, package and download reuse. Exact local object key/byte-hash certificates use the existing guarded object channel; original ZIP CRC/manifest/payload and cancel flow remain.

Only eight named current-spec GET read models may extend dispatch for original UI3/4. Existing migrated115 and native producer routes are explicitly excluded from this extension. No fallback after candidate status/transport failure.

C found original full-source01 send retained the response only after SDK/PG/adopt. Final source02 immediately retains the actual Native setup response/context/method/path/body in new M private as soon as HTTP returns. Later proof failure preserves the response and active unresolved case; the failed-proof pure regression models this without any actual I/O.

Reviewed UI1 source02 browser credential whitelist, exact Linux process owner, nofollow new-private recording, full107 original baseline and independent close attempts are inherited. Queue cancellation and unresolved PG/source-preparer cases remain explicit; observer restore/owned drain/double cleanup require all attempted writers stopped and no active case.
